title: Albaghdady Plate (طبق البغدادي)
description: Our signature breakfast spread. Ground meat kabab, golden potatoes, eggplant tomato stew, and two pieces of handmade kubbah — all on one tray.

title: Kahi & Qeimar (كاهي وقيمر)
description: Iraq's most beloved sweet breakfast. Layers of flaky golden kahi pastry drizzled with syrup, served with rich clotted cream (qeimar).

title: Baqila (باقلاء بالدهن)
description: Tender fava beans simmered in their own broth, served with eggs, crispy fried onions, and warm bread soaked in the broth. A national Iraqi tradition.

title: Kubba (كبة)
description: Four hand-rolled pieces of Iraqi kubba — bulgur shells stuffed with seasoned meat, onions, and herbs, fried until golden and crisp.

title: Qeimar & Debes (قيمر ودبس)
description: Fresh clotted cream and pure date syrup, served with warm samoon. Simple, ancient, unforgettable.

title: Chelfry (جلفراي)
description: Traditional Iraqi morning hash of slow-cooked lamb pieces, golden potatoes, onions, and tomatoes. Bold and warming.

title: Omlet (مخلمة)
description: Iraqi-style omelette with ground meat, fresh tomatoes, onions, and eggs cooked together until tender and rich.

title: Bastirma (باسترما بالبيض)
description: Spiced cured beef sausage sizzled with eggs until the edges crisp. Deep, smoky flavor in every bite.

title: Lamb Liver (معلاك غنم)
description: Fresh lamb liver sautéed with onions and tomatoes until tender. The way Baghdadi mornings have started for generations.

title: Beef & Egg (لحم وبيض)
description: Tender beef shawarma topped with a perfectly cooked egg. Savory, satisfying, ready to fuel your whole morning.

title: Potato with Egg (بطاطا مع بيض)
description: Pan-fried potatoes scrambled with farm-fresh eggs. Simple, comforting, pairs perfectly with hot chai.

title: Tomato with Egg (طماطم مع بيض)
description: Ripe tomatoes slow-cooked with eggs into a rich, savory scramble. Light, fresh, a Middle Eastern breakfast staple.

title: Fried Kabab (كباب عروق)
description: Hand-formed patties of seasoned ground meat with fresh parsley and onions, pan-fried golden and crisp.

title: Pistachio Mabrouma
description: A premium version of our house mabrouma — loaded with fresh-ground pistachios throughout, baked deep gold and finished with syrup.

title: Bird's Nest (Osh Al Asfour)
description: Delicate shredded phyllo nests filled with pistachios and soaked in floral syrup. A beautiful and festive Iraqi sweet.

title: Burma (Turkish Style)
description: Long, cigar-rolled phyllo packed with pistachios and finished with syrup. Crisp, nutty, and one of the lesser-known Iraqi sweets.

title: Mabrouma with Cream
description: Our classic coiled phyllo pastry filled with luscious sweet cream and pistachios, baked until golden.

title: Pistachio Baklava
description: Our most-ordered variety. Generous layers of fresh-ground pistachios between paper-thin phyllo, soaked in just enough syrup.

title: Mixed Baklava
description: Layers of phyllo, walnut, pistachio and honey. A mixed selection of our house baklava varieties.

title: Walnut Baklava
description: A traditional baklava variety made with fresh walnuts. Layers of paper-thin phyllo, walnuts, and our family's signature honey syrup. The recipe we've been making since 1919.

title: Kanafa
description: Sticky shredded phyllo with melted cheese, soaked in rose-water syrup and topped with crushed pistachios.

title: Ladyfingers (Znood Al Sit)
description: Crispy phyllo rolls filled with sweet cream and dipped in syrup.

title: Awama (Luqaimat)
description: Bite-sized fried dough fritters, crisp on the outside, soft inside, soaked in our family's honey syrup. A celebration favorite at every Iraqi gathering — most often spotted on Eid and wedding trays.

title: Dehena (Iraqi Dessert)
description: A traditional Iraqi sweet made with date syrup and butter — warm, rich, and deeply comforting. A true taste of Baghdad.

title: Iraqi Samoon (4 pc)
description: Iraq's traditional oval-shaped bread, baked fresh in our stone oven throughout the day.

title: Tandoor Bread (6 pc)
description: Traditional flatbread baked in our tandoor oven. Soft, chewy, and perfect with any meal.

title: Iraqi Bread (3 pc)
description: Classic Iraqi-style round bread, baked fresh daily.

title: Bread (1 pc)
description: Single piece of freshly baked bread.

title: Samoon (1 pc)
description: Single piece of our signature Iraqi samoon bread.

title: Manakish
description: Flatbread topped with za'atar, cheese, or meat — Middle Eastern breakfast at its most authentic. A weekend staple in our Richardson bakery.

title: Fatayer — Spinach
description: Hand-folded savory pies with spinach filling, baked fresh daily. Soft, golden, perfect with chai.

title: Fatayer — Cheese
description: Hand-folded savory pies with cheese filling, baked fresh daily.

title: Fatayer — Meat
description: Hand-folded savory pies with seasoned ground meat, baked fresh daily.

title: Sour Kibbeh (Bowl)
description: Kibbeh served in a tangy tamarind-based broth. A beloved Iraqi comfort dish, best eaten with fresh samoon.

title: Kibbeh
description: Fried bulgur shell stuffed with spiced ground meat, onions, and pine nuts. Crispy outside, rich and savory inside.

title: Chickpea Soup (Leblebi)
description: Hearty chickpea soup seasoned with cumin and lemon, served with toasted bread. A classic Iraqi street-food staple.

title: Samosa
description: Hand-folded and pan-fried golden. Choose from seasoned ground meat or vegetable filling — crispy on the outside, savory inside. Perfect as a quick snack, an appetizer, or by the tray for your next gathering.

title: Egg Roll
description: Crispy rolled pastry with a savory filling, fried golden and served hot.

title: Karak Chai
description: Our signature variety. Rich, creamy black tea slowly steeped with cardamom, milk, and a touch of sweetness — the way Iraqi mornings are meant to start.

title: Yemeni Coffee
description: Aromatic spiced coffee brewed Yemeni-style — warm, fragrant, and deeply satisfying.

title: Apricot Drink (Torshana)
description: A traditional Iraqi dried-apricot drink — sweet, tangy, and refreshing. A Ramadan and celebration staple.

title: Raisin Juice
description: Naturally sweet juice made from soaked raisins. Light, refreshing, and full of flavor.

title: Dried Lime Juice (Loomi)
description: A uniquely Iraqi drink made from dried black limes. Tart, earthy, and unlike anything else.

title: Small Cone
description: A single scoop of creamy ice cream in a classic crispy cone.

title: Large Cone
description: A generous scoop of creamy ice cream in a large crispy cone.

title: Ice Cream Cup
description: Creamy ice cream served in a cup — no cone, just the good stuff.
